instruction: Publish with message priority via mosquitto_pub
output: mosquitto_pub --topic 'alerts/critical' --message 'device down' -V 5 -D pub message-expiry-interval '30' -D pub payload-format-indicator '0'

instruction: Subscribe to system topics with MQTT v5
output: mosquitto_sub --topic '$SYS/broker/

instruction: Set MQTT session expiry to 1 hour on subscribe
output: mosquitto_sub --topic 'data/

instruction: Publish using topic alias in MQTT v5
output: mosquitto_pub --topic 't' --message 'payload' -V 5 -D connect topic-alias-maximum '10' -D publish topic-alias '1'

instruction: Mosquitto bridge configuration for multi-broker
output:
echo 'connection bridge-to-remote
address 10.0.0.2:1883
topic

instruction: Reload Mosquitto config after bridge change
output: sudo systemctl reload mosquitto

instruction: Check Mosquitto broker status
output: sudo systemctl status mosquitto

instruction: View Mosquitto log file
output: sudo tail -f /var/log/mosquitto/mosquitto.log

instruction: Enable Mosquitto verbose logging
output:
echo 'log_type all
connection_messages true
log_dest file /var/log/mosquitto/mosquitto.log' | sudo tee /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/logging.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Set Mosquitto listener on port 9001 for WebSocket
output:
echo 'listener 9001
protocol websockets' | sudo tee /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/websockets.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Set Mosquitto TLS listener on port 8883
output:
echo 'listener 8883
cafile /etc/mosquitto/ca.crt
certfile /etc/mosquitto/server.crt
keyfile /etc/mosquitto/server.key
require_certificate false' | sudo tee /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/tls.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Set Mosquitto password authentication
output:
echo 'password_file /etc/mosquitto/passwd
allow_anonymous false' | sudo tee /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/auth.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Set Mosquitto ACL file for fine-grained access
output: echo 'acl_file /etc/mosquitto/acl' | sudo tee /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/acl.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Create Mosquitto ACL rules
output:
echo 'user alice
topic sensor/

instruction: Set Mosquitto max connections limit
output: echo 'max_connections 1000' | sudo tee /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/limits.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Set Mosquitto message size limit
output: echo 'message_size_limit 65535' | sudo tee /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/limits.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Set Mosquitto to store retained messages to disk
output:
echo 'persistence true
persistence_location /var/lib/mosquitto/' | sudo tee /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/persistence.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Set Mosquitto to autosave every 60 seconds
output: echo 'autosave_interval 60' | sudo tee -a /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/persistence.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Set Mosquitto queue QoS and max inflight
output:
echo 'max_inflight_messages 100
max_queued_messages 1000' | sudo tee /etc/mosquitto/conf.d/queues.conf && sudo systemctl restart mosquitto

instruction: Test Mosquitto broker with PING/REQ
output: mosquitto_sub --topic 'test/ping' -W 5 && mosquitto_pub --topic 'test/ping' --message '' -n

instruction: Publish to MQTT via SSL with protocol version
output: mosquitto_pub --topic 'secure/topic' --message 'data' --tls-version tlsv1.3 --cafile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

instruction: Subscribe with topic filter that has $ sign
output: mosquitto_sub --topic '$SYS/#' -v
